workflow_health.scope: Completed physical calls, same invocation, exact tool/input/output/status, with each preceding call finished before the next began. Readonly names are grep, ls, read_file and glob. No runtime suppression, forced return, tail removal or source acceptance is performed.

historical_rejected_v152_health_same_aud.scope: Completed physical calls, same invocation, exact tool/input/output/status, with each preceding call finished before the next began. Readonly names are grep, ls, read_file and glob. No runtime suppression, forced return, tail removal or source acceptance is performed.

same_session_previously_served_input.scope: Prefix-missing proxy only; excludes initial cold input and newly appended input. It is not actual kernel recomputation or proof of eviction cause.

sampled_restore_wait.scope: One-in-16 load-consuming prefill batch observations, including event overhead. Does not measure capacity or queue waits and is not an end-to-end oracle bound.

host_block_eviction_attribution.full_reaccess_semantics: exact prefix match plus request device/host cached-token intervals; remaining evicted FULL interval is attributed to recomputation
host_block_eviction_attribution.identity_semantics: run-keyed HMAC over exact cache namespace and radix token prefix; raw token IDs are not written
host_block_eviction_attribution.mamba_reaccess_semantics: exact prefix revisit is observable, but native telemetry does not expose the Mamba hit location per node
